paper_title: A SQUID-based microwave cavity search for dark-matter axions
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: ADMX first SQUID-amplifier run. Excludes KSVZ axion dark matter (rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3) at 90% CL over 3.3-3.53 ueV. Paper does not tabulate g_agamma; the reported result is exclusion of realistic KSVZ models over this mass band (Fig. 5). Data points are the KSVZ coupling values at the band endpoints, computed via g_agamma = g_gamma*alpha/(pi*f_a) with g_gamma~0.97 and m_a-f_a relation; treat as approximate KSVZ-level limit endpoints. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.6, 22)) | Vision: Figure 5, ADMX SQUID search. X-axis Frequency 815-860 MHz converted to axion mass via m=4.136e-15*f. Top axis confirms 3.35-3.5 ueV. Exclusion at 90% CL for rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The excluded (hatched) region is a jagged step-like band just above the KSVZ line (~1e-15 GeV^-1). Lower boundary traced ~1.4-1.9e-15. Fine step structure is not fully resolvable at image resolution; values are approximate. DFSZ line lies below at ~4e-16. | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=1.33 snapped to identity)
